say:1:1711125001:1.text: Oh? Where did this stray dog ​​come from?

choice_prompt:2:1711125001.text: Oh? Where did this stray dog ​​come from?

say:5:1711125006:1.text: Oh dear, no wonder. Our fox clan has recently experienced a historic turn of fortune!
say:5:1711125006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这也难怪。最近我们狐狸一族可是迎来了历史性的大转运！

say:6:1711125007:1.text: I wonder which great comrade displayed such divine power on the street that he has won over humanity!
say:6:1711125007:1.source_cn: 不知道哪位伟大的同胞在街头大展神威，折服了人类！

say:7:1711125008:1.text: Thanks to it, "raising foxes" is now the most fashionable pastime among the nobles of the capital!
say:7:1711125008:1.source_cn: 托它的福，“养狐狸”现在可是王都贵族们里最时髦的消遣！

choice_prompt:9:1711125009.text: Now I don't have to do anything all day. All I have to do is yawn or roll over, and they'll take good care of me. This feeling... burp, it's just wonderful.
choice_prompt:9:1711125009.source_cn: 我现在每天什么都不用干，只要打个哈欠、翻个肚皮，就能被他们精心伺候。这种感觉……嗝，真是太美妙了。

say:10:1711125010:1.text: What? Why are you asking about this?
say:10:1711125010:1.source_cn: 怎么？你打听这个干什么？

say:13:1711125012:1.text: Let's bear with it for now, as long as we can get a clue!
say:13:1711125012:1.source_cn: 暂时忍受一下吧，只要能拿到线索！

choice_prompt:16:1711125015.text: Look at you, so fierce-looking, and your fur is so rough! Even if you learn to be affectionate, humans will only think you're going to bite. That's a natural difference, understand?
choice_prompt:16:1711125015.source_cn: 你看你这副凶神恶煞的样子，毛还这么粗糙！就算学会了撒娇，人类也只会觉得你要咬人。这是天生的差距，懂吗？

choice_prompt:18:1711125016.text: Well... I've never seen that great fellow countryman. It's said to be elusive and never stays in one place for long.
choice_prompt:18:1711125016.source_cn: 这个嘛……我从来没见过那位伟大的同胞，据说它神出鬼没，从不在一个地方停留太久。

say:19:1711125017:1.text: Oh, look at you, so dejected and pathetic. Let me share some food with you.
say:19:1711125017:1.source_cn: 哎，看你这副垂头丧气的可怜样。我分你点食物吃吃吧。

say:21:1711125019:1.text: Take all the roast chicken, foie gras, caviar, and that half-bottle of wine!
say:21:1711125019:1.source_cn: 这里的烤鸡、鹅肝、鱼子酱、还有那半瓶美酒，都拿去吧！

say:24:1711125022:1.text: Since things have come to this, let's take some with us!
say:24:1711125022:1.source_cn: 事已至此，就带走一些吧！

choice:16:0:1.text: ...I understand, but please tell me quickly.

choice:12:0:1.text: ...You can understand it that way too.

say:26:1711125013:1.text: Let's not hide it; the pursuit of better food is an instinct of us four-legged creatures.
say:26:1711125013:1.source_cn: 别掩饰了，追求更美好的食物是我们四条腿生物的本能。

choice:12:1:2.text: I just want to find him

choice:9:0:1.text: Have you ever met your "great compatriots"?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 那你见过“伟大的同胞”吗？

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 所以你很崇拜那只狐狸？

say:28:1711125004:1.text: Look away, you country bumpkin, this is my special afternoon tea.
say:28:1711125004:1.source_cn: 把你的眼睛挪开，乡巴狗，这可是我专属的下午茶。

choice:2:2:3.text: This foie gras is indeed quite delicious.
